history.title: טולי והים שבא והולך
history.summary: Tuli, a small sea turtle on the Tel Aviv beach, notices the sea coming and going. Grandma turtle explains that the Moon's gentle pull makes the tides; here the sea moves only a turtle's step, in far places it climbs a giant staircase. Refrain: ששש... הים בא. ששש... הים הולך. Music: Debussy, Clair de lune.

options.title: Mira and the Magnet That Loved Metal
options.summary: A curious girl discovers that her grandfather's little magnet only wants to hug spoons and nails, never wood or paper, and learns about the invisible pull called magnetism.

options.title: Pip the Firefly's First Light
options.summary: A small firefly who can't make his light glow yet watches his family blink across the garden and discovers, ever so gently, how to switch on his own quiet glow.

options.title: Little Leo and the Rainbow Puddle
options.summary: A boy who only ever paints blue skies steps in a puddle after the rain and discovers the whole rainbow hiding upside down in the water.

options.title: Ella Duckling and the Big Bass Drum
options.summary: A little duckling at a park bandstand is startled by a booming drum until she learns it is only a friendly instrument that goes boom when a soft mallet taps its skin.
options.music: Johann Strauss Sr. – Radetzky March (listen for the steady drum beats)

options.title: Yara the Camel Crosses the Golden Dunes
options.summary: A young camel walks across the desert at sunset toward a starlit oasis and discovers what she is really carrying in the hump on her back.
